column1: # The aapp commands a supported plugin may ask for in its `do` list, per subject.
# A line of the list is accepted when it is one of these commands, alone or
# followed by arguments; any other line is refused and reported.
# Reference: docs/reference/07-issue-protocol.md (kept equal by a test).
#   subject : the subject of the step (issue)
#   command : the command, as typed after `aapp`
